case_details.age_at_procedure_years.notes: 0–120; derive where possible. Snapshot at this procedure; do not overwrite prior procedures.

case_details.airway_size_unit.definition: ETT inner diameter is mm; SGA size is a manufacturer size number.

case_details.asa_physical_status.notes: Emergency modifier stored separately in asa_emergency_modifier.

case_details.intent.definition: Coded purpose of this component/case: diagnosis, staging, combined diagnosis/staging, restaging or molecular rebiopsy. Do not infer from billing codes.

case_details.operator_id.definition: Foreign key linking this row to its parent operator record.

case_details.pack_years.definition: Best estimate of cumulative cigarette exposure.
case_details.pack_years.notes: Nonnegative. Snapshot at this procedure; do not overwrite prior procedures.

case_details.procedure_duration_minutes.definition: Documented total procedure duration in minutes; if calculated, use documented bronchoscope-in and final bronchoscope-out times and retain the derivation. An isolated timestamp is insufficient.

case_details.sex_at_birth.definition: Biologic sex used for clinical risk adjustment.

case_details.smoking_status.notes: Snapshot at this procedure; do not overwrite prior procedures.

complications.adverse_event_id.definition: Unique immutable identifier for this row.

complications.procedure_component_attrib.definition: Component thought responsible; combined cases need not have a certain assignment.

complications.relative_day_offset.definition: Documented or locally derived day offset from the procedure, limited to days 0–30. Missing timing remains null; do not default to day zero.

complications.state.definition: Presence, explicit absence, uncertainty or missing documentation of the named immediate/interval event. Absence must be documented for the applicable event/window.

ebus_sessions.incomplete_exam_reason.definition: Why the intended survey/sampling was incomplete.

ebus_sessions.performed_sampling_strateg.definition: Actual strategy; document deviations rather than revising the original plan.

ebus_sessions.planned_sampling_strategy.definition: Intended strategy before results are known.

ebus_sessions.primary_purpose.definition: Keep initial staging, diagnosis and restaging distinct.

ebus_sessions.systematic_exam_complete.capture: Derived with versioned rule and audit
ebus_sessions.systematic_exam_complete.definition: Operator-reported completion; audited completeness is separately derived.

field_provenance.assertion_context.definition: Distinguish planned, performed, historical and negated mentions.

field_provenance.conflict_status.definition: Whether another source disagrees with this assertion.

field_provenance.derivation_rule_version.capture: Derived with versioned rule and audit
field_provenance.derivation_rule_version.definition: Calculation or reconciliation rule used for derived values.

field_provenance.extractor_model_version.definition: Exact model or parser version, not a generic product name.

field_provenance.field_path.definition: Canonical snake_case field name in that table.

field_provenance.missingness_reason.definition: Reason no actual value can be established; not a numeric sentinel.

field_provenance.source_digest.definition: Hash used to detect unexpected changes in the same source version.

field_provenance.source_document_id.definition: Immutable supporting document; nullable only for generated/derived fields with explicit basis.

field_provenance.source_end.definition: Zero-based exclusive end in the exact immutable source text. Whitespace is retained so excerpt and offsets agree.

field_provenance.source_excerpt.definition: Minimal necessary evidence supporting the assertion, kept in restricted storage.

field_provenance.source_start.definition: Zero-based character offset in the exact immutable source text; inclusive start. Paired with exclusive end, source ID, SHA-256 and verbatim excerpt.

field_provenance.value_origin.definition: Do not confuse an observed clinical fact with a calculation or model inference.

follow_up.complete.definition: Explicitly completed ascertainment for the entire selected interval. A contact alone does not establish complete ascertainment or negative outcomes.

follow_up.ed_visit.definition: Any ED evaluation since prior contact.

follow_up.safety_ascertainment_status.definition: No events can only be asserted if the window was actually assessed.

follow_up.window.definition: Assessment interval: days 0–7 or days 8–30. This records the interval assessed, not simply the day a follow-up note was authored.

localization_events.actual_lesion_vs_vir.definition: Whether the sampled tissue lesion or only an overlay is seen.

localization_events.confirmation_basis.definition: Method underlying the claimed tool-to-lesion confirmation.

localization_events.event_sequence_numbe.definition: Order of confirmation events for lesion.

localization_events.final_prebiopsy_conf.definition: Marks localization state immediately before acquisition.
localization_events.final_prebiopsy_conf.notes: At most one unless position changes.

localization_events.localization_event_i.definition: Unique immutable identifier for this row.

localization_events.localization_modalit.definition: Modality used to localize target or tool.

localization_events.navigation_run_id.definition: Foreign key linking this row to its parent navigation_run record.

localization_events.position_correction_.definition: Whether catheter/tool was repositioned based on event.

localization_events.sampling_tool_presen.definition: Whether the actual sampling tool was in position during imaging.

localization_events.target_id.definition: Foreign key linking this row to its parent peripheral_lesion record.

localization_events.tool_lesion_relation.definition: Prespecified relationship of actual sampling tool to segmented lesion.
localization_events.tool_lesion_relation.notes: Do not infer TIL from radial probe visualization, virtual distance, ROSE or diagnostic pathology. Require actual sampling tool and actual lesion, documented modality and versioned confirmation rule. Keep modality-stratified results.

localization_events.verified_tool_compon.definition: What portion of the actual device was assessed.

navigation_runs.navigation_run_id.definition: Unique immutable identifier for this row.

navigation_runs.platform_family.definition: Registry grouping, not an inference about which imaging was used.

navigation_runs.target_id.definition: Foreign key linking this row to its parent peripheral_lesion record.

navigation_runs.target_reached_operation.definition: Registry-defined arrival criterion independent of diagnosis.

pathology_results.adequate_for_primary_d.definition: Enough material to establish/exclude a specific diagnosis for intended question.

pathology_results.index_result_class.definition: Index bronchoscopy result before follow-up using strict categories.
pathology_results.index_result_class.notes: Atypia, suspicious cells, nonspecific inflammation, normal lung, blood, necrosis, and insufficient tissue do not count as strict diagnostic successes.

pathology_results.lymphoid_material_adeq.definition: Cytopathology's assessment of nodal tissue representation.

pathology_results.pathology_result_id.definition: Unique immutable identifier for this row.

pathology_results.result_status.definition: Distinguish preliminary, final and amended reports.

pathology_results.specimen_id.definition: Foreign key linking this row to its parent specimen record.

pathology_results.supersedes_pathology_r.definition: Prior result replaced by the current amended report.

pathology_results.target_id.definition: Exact lesion/node to which result applies.

procedures.category.definition: Launch component: diagnostic robotic bronchoscopy or transbronchial linear EBUS. Generic peripheral navigation, standalone radial EBUS/EUS-B and robotic ablation are not relabeled as eligible components.

procedures.completion.definition: Completion of the named component, recorded independently from whether it was attempted/performed.

procedures.performance.definition: Documented component action state, with started attempts retained even when unsuccessful or aborted. Unknown eligibility requires review.

sampling_acquisitions.acquisition_record.definition: Actual single pass versus reported aggregate; do not manufacture pass-level data.

sampling_acquisitions.attribution_status.definition: Whether all material in the container comes from one identifiable target.

sampling_acquisitions.localization_event.definition: Best localization evidence immediately preceding activation.

sampling_acquisitions.reported_pass_coun.definition: Count represented by this row; one for a single-pass row.
sampling_acquisitions.reported_pass_coun.notes: Positive integer; aggregate counts contribute their actual reported count.

sampling_acquisitions.rose_adequate.definition: Adequacy explicitly documented at ROSE for this acquisition. Keep separate from final pathology adequacy.

sampling_acquisitions.sampling_pass_id.definition: Unique immutable identifier for this row.

sampling_acquisitions.tool_size_mm.definition: Gauge, diameter, length, angle, or size descriptor.

sampling_specimen_links.allocation_purpo.definition: Purpose of this split of material.

sampling_specimen_links.link_certainty.definition: How reliably the exact pass can be linked to the container.

sampling_specimen_links.sampling_pass_id.notes: Must resolve to the corresponding parent; match patient and procedure.

sampling_specimen_links.specimen_id.notes: Must resolve to the corresponding parent; match patient and procedure.

specimens.pathology.definition: Optional compatibility summary only. Target diagnostic measures use attributed, non-superseded final/amended pathology_results with explicit index scope.
specimens.pathology.notes: Atypia, suspicious cells, nonspecific inflammation, normal lung, blood, necrosis, and insufficient tissue do not count as strict diagnostic successes.

specimens.specimen_id.definition: Unique immutable identifier for this row.

specimens.target_attribution_status.definition: Whether all material in the container comes from one identifiable target.

station_surveys.ebus_session_id.definition: Links station or target to the linear EBUS/EUS-B session.

station_surveys.iaslc_station.notes: Use versioned IASLC map; retain unspecific labels without inventing substation. This vocabulary does not imply access by EBUS/EUS.

station_surveys.largest_short_axis_mm.applies: Node visualized; capture confirmed short axis or the supported missingness reason.
station_surveys.largest_short_axis_mm.definition: Largest confirmed nodal short-axis measurement in the station on EBUS/EUS-B. Record the ultrasound measurement separately from CT.
station_surveys.largest_short_axis_mm.notes: Nonnegative. Populate only when the ultrasound short axis is explicit. Never relabel an unspecified-axis size or substitute a CT dimension.

station_surveys.size_axis_explicit.applies: Node visualized; capture confirmed short axis or the supported missingness reason.
station_surveys.size_axis_explicit.definition: Whether the largest ultrasound size is explicitly documented as short axis, without inferring an axis from one or two unlabeled measurements.
station_surveys.size_axis_explicit.notes: Nonnegative. Populate only when the ultrasound short axis is explicit. Never relabel an unspecified-axis size or substitute a CT dimension.

station_surveys.station_sampled.definition: Whether any target in station was sampled.

station_surveys.station_survey_id.definition: Unique immutable identifier for this row.

station_surveys.station_visualized.definition: Whether recognizable station anatomy was obtained.

targets.anatomic_label.definition: Stable clinician-readable label, not a substitute for location fields.

targets.benign_lymphoid_tissue_present.definition: Document explicitly; a malignant node need not contain benign lymphocytes.

targets.bronchus_sign_present.definition: Bronchus visibly leading to or entering lesion.

targets.diagnostic_attempted.definition: Navigation, localization or sampling started for this prespecified biopsy target. Planned-only targets and docking without a diagnostic attempt do not establish this flag; failures remain attempts.

targets.ebus_session_id.definition: Links station or target to the linear EBUS/EUS-B session.

targets.iaslc_station.notes: Use versioned IASLC map; retain unspecific labels without inventing substation. This vocabulary does not imply access by EBUS/EUS.

targets.max_diameter_mm.definition: Maximum cross-sectional diameter on planning study.

targets.measurement_modality.applies: Nodal target evaluated; capture confirmed short axis or the supported missingness reason.
targets.measurement_modality.definition: Documented ultrasound route of the explicit short-axis measurement. A CT or unspecified measurement cannot be substituted.
targets.measurement_modality.notes: Nonnegative. Populate only when the ultrasound short axis is explicit. Never relabel an unspecified-axis size or substitute a CT dimension.

targets.nodal_adequacy_basis.definition: Pathologist-supported lymphoid tissue, definitive tumor, or another basis.

targets.node_interpretation.capture: Derived with versioned rule and audit
targets.node_interpretation.definition: Cached current interpretation from target_outcome; not from ROSE alone.

targets.pet_description.definition: Original documented PET assessment. No PET result is inferred from a planned study or from the lesion diagnosis.

targets.prespecified_biopsy_target.definition: Target selected for biopsy before bronchoscopy starts.

targets.reason_sampling_not_attempted.definition: Retain prespecified targets even when their workup is stopped.

targets.rose_adequate.definition: Adequacy explicitly documented at rapid on-site evaluation for this target. Final specimen adequacy does not establish ROSE adequacy.

targets.sampling_attempted.definition: Actual effort to sample this target, including failed access.

targets.short_axis_mm.applies: Nodal target evaluated; capture confirmed short axis or the supported missingness reason.
targets.short_axis_mm.definition: Confirmed short-axis diameter of this target on EBUS/EUS-B immediately before sampling. Do not substitute CT measurements.
targets.short_axis_mm.notes: Nonnegative. Populate only when the ultrasound short axis is explicit. Never relabel an unspecified-axis size or substitute a CT dimension.

targets.site.definition: Identity type; do not force nonnodal EUS-B targets into a lymph-node station.

targets.size_axis_explicit.applies: Nodal target evaluated; capture confirmed short axis or the supported missingness reason.
targets.size_axis_explicit.definition: True only when ultrasound measurement is explicitly identified as short axis in the source. Unspecified or long-axis measurements do not populate short_axis_mm.
targets.size_axis_explicit.notes: Nonnegative. Populate only when the ultrasound short axis is explicit. Never relabel an unspecified-axis size or substitute a CT dimension.

targets.specimen_obtained.definition: Any specimen actually retrieved for this target.

targets.station_survey_id.applies: Nodal target with a station survey; nullable for nonnodal EUS-B targets
targets.station_survey_id.definition: Foreign key linking this row to its parent ebus_station_survey record.

targets.target_id.definition: Encounter-local target row ID. Station identity and individual-node or longitudinal target identity remain separate.

targets.target_identity_id.definition: Persistent target identity across repeat procedures.
targets.target_identity_id.notes: Same patient. Multiple nodes in one station may have distinct identities; do not assume individual-node correspondence from station alone.

catheter_or_tool_changed_after_confirmat.title: Catheter Or Tool Changed After Confirmation
